title: Add sdlc work-item and task listing commands
objective: Add read-only sdlc work-item list and sdlc task list <work-item-id> commands that enumerate canonical work-item and task records deterministically.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on the main branch and the user requested preparation and commit of the work item on the current repository.

request.text: Prepare a new .docs/work-items/WI-0002 to add the following commands: sdlc work-item list [ list .docs/work-items/* ] sdlc task list <work-item-id> [ list .docs/work-items/tasks ] Commit the work item upon completion.

scope.name: work-item-discovery-command
scope.description: Add sdlc work-item list to enumerate work-item directories and their canonical work-item.json records under .docs/work-items/.
scope.reason: Users need a deterministic top-level inventory before selecting a work item.

scope.name: task-discovery-command
scope.description: Add sdlc task list <work-item-id> to enumerate the selected work item’s task envelopes from its declared stepsPath directory.
scope.reason: Users need a deterministic task inventory scoped to one work item without executing or mutating tasks.

nonGoals.name: task-execution
nonGoals.description: Do not execute, mutate, approve, or transition work items or tasks while listing them.
nonGoals.reason: The requested commands are read-only discovery surfaces.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-production-runtime
nonGoals.description: Do not add provider calls, HTTP services, persistence, deployment, or production release behavior.
nonGoals.reason: WI-0002 is limited to local filesystem discovery and terminal serialization.

items.name: list-work-items
items.description: sdlc work-item list must enumerate valid work-item records below .docs/work-items/ in deterministic order and report stable identity, lifecycle status, title, and record path without modifying files.
items.reason: A top-level inventory is the entry point for selecting a work item and must be reproducible across runs.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Running sdlc work-item list returns a zero exit code, lists WI-0001 and WI-0002 in natural work-item order, and does not write to .docs/work-items/.
The command reports each discovered work item’s ID, title, status, and repository-relative work-item.json path.

items.name: list-work-item-tasks
items.description: sdlc task list <work-item-id> must resolve the selected work item’s stepsPath and enumerate its valid task envelopes in deterministic order without executing or modifying them.
items.reason: Task discovery must remain scoped to the selected work item and use the canonical task directory declared by work-item.json.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Running sdlc task list WI-0001 lists the four WI-0001 task UIDs, task types, processing statuses, and task paths in order.
An unknown work-item ID returns a stable non-zero result and an actionable error without writing files.

items.name: discovery-cli-tests
items.description: Both discovery commands must have focused deterministic tests covering successful listing, ordering, malformed or missing records, and read-only behavior.
items.reason: Filesystem discovery is a user-visible boundary and must fail clearly rather than silently skipping invalid selection input.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The focused test suite covers both command routes and completes successfully with yarn test.
